response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.insurstat AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS site_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat) SELECT status, site_count, 1.0 * site_count / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts;

assumptions.assumption: A conserved site is counted once per insurance status even if it has multiple conservation records; NULL insurance status forms its own group.

alternatives.interpretation: Count conservation records associated with sites, including multiple records for the same site.
alternatives.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.insurstat AS status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat) SELECT status, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts;
